environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate task in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/24). The subnet route table has only a local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint for internet-bound traffic, and no transit gateway attachment. The VPC has no internet gateway route propagated to this subnet. Security group allows inbound from ALB only (port 8000) and egress is restricted to the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16) only. Network ACL on the subnet explicitly denies all outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 except responses to the ALB health check subnet (10.0.0.0/24 ephemeral ports). DNS resolution is via Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint within the VPC only. The task IAM role has no permissions beyond ECR pull and CloudWatch Logs. There is no VPC peering or PrivateLink to any external service.

config.dns: Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint, VPC-internal only
